description: Write. Turns a paused link back on: taps follow it again within about 30 seconds. Needs confirm: true; without it nothing changes and you get a preview (it looks the link up among paused links). A link disabled for breaking the acceptable use policy cannot be resumed, and if another active link now uses the slug, pause or rename that one first. list_links with status: paused lists paused links.

confirm.description: true to resume; omit or false to preview

slug.description: The link's slug: the part after the link domain, e.g. `summer` in https://hilltop.strait.link/summer

name: resume_link
title: Resume a paused link
